stance: Consumer sentiment is weak: 48.1 in September after 51.7 in August, close to the May 2026 record low of 44.8. Soft sentiment tends to foreshadow softer retail spending, but the two decouple often, so we wait for hard spending data. German Ifo climate rose to 90.2 from 89.9 in October (unconfirmed, single source), led by expectations while current assessment slipped, a modest offset for EUR. No inflation expectations data logged yet. Stance: cautious, bearish lean on consumer, low conviction. A rebound above 52 or firm retail sales would soften the view.
